## Disclosures

- The NBA corpus was already scored exploratorily by P5 and by the S542 before-probe; only the lag scenarios, the event-aware anchor and the extended sigma grid are unseen.
- Polymarket price-point semantics are undocumented; the price at ts is treated as known at ts.
- ESPN wallclock is whole seconds; its alignment with the venue clock is NOT VERIFIED.
- L is a scenario for NBA and a measurement for MLB; the MLB STALE is our own previous receipt.
- Any SHRINK coefficient here is Polymarket-specific; a Kalshi anchor uses c = 0 until fitted on Kalshi.
- Sigma is cross-fit: each season's sigma is chosen on the other season at L = 18.
- OT uses the OT clock in the same formula; no 300 s staleness rail applies at L != 0.
- No ledger trial is charged: this is a research replay, not a SHIP trial.

## NOT VERIFIED

- ESPN wallclock versus venue clock alignment
- Polymarket point meaning (open, close or VWAP) behind each r1 price
- whether a feed delay of 18 s on NBA matches any live NBA feed
- MLB cells are descriptive only (single window, own receipts)
